name: operational_parameters
description: Values that owners saved for the operational parameters declared by the runtime catalog in apps/api/src/parameters.ts (ADR-0028). The catalog owns each parameter's type, domain, installation default and effect; a missing row or a null value means the installation default applies. Secrets and bootstrap settings are never stored here.
lifecycle: At most one row per catalog key, written only by owners through administration with strong recent authentication; a reset stores null instead of deleting. Every change is recorded in identity_audit_events with previous and new values.

columns.Meaning: Catalog key of the parameter, such as ai.model.
Saved JSON value in the catalog type of the key (string or array of strings).
columns.Null meaning: Reset by an owner; the installation default applies.

columns.Meaning: Concurrency token incremented by every change; an owner's change applies only to the version they saw.
Person (identity_persons.id) who made the last change; historical attribution without a foreign key, because the authoritative trail is the identity audit.
Application-clock instant of the last change; informational, not the concurrency token.

constraints.Purpose: Only parameters declared by the catalog.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR (((key)::text = 'ai.model'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'::text) AND ((value #>> '{}'::text[]) ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,99}$'::text)) OR (((key)::text = 'ai.traceLevel'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'::text) AND ((value #>> '{}'::text[]) = ANY (ARRAY['off'::text, 'metadata'::text, 'content'::text]))) OR (((key)::text = 'access.providerGrants'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(value) <= 32) AND (NOT jsonb_path_exists(value, '$[*]?(@.type() != "string")'::jsonpath)))))
constraints.Purpose: Each known key holds only its catalog type and domain (model identifier pattern, trace level, list of at most 32 strings).
